reason: Preserve the live-proven identity/reconnect path and stop K2 from issuing StopServer solely because the manager-owned creator transport disconnected.
observed_failure: The v37 live test proved game.dll retained the creator but the slave still exited about 120 ms later. Ghidra identified the independent cause in K2 CHostServer removal: when the departing client is the special local creator at CHostServer+0x180, K2 invokes game RemoveClient, frees the connection, and unconditionally queues the console command StopServer. V38 bypasses only that command for server-manager-owned dedicated slaves; unmanaged/local hosts retain stock shutdown behavior.
